status: One unadopted, unqualified, literature-only operation. No driver or launch.
factor_sites: Only native HGT relation-message linear branches: global member input factor before source-type message map; output factor after canonical relation transform and before weighted neighbor aggregation. Other branches retain shared native parameters and per-member state. Source must bind head concatenation, biases and exact order.
native_shared_parameters: Type/relation cores, Q/K/attention, output/skip maps, normalization, heads; exact source map binding pending.
private_state: Every member retains complete hidden states, native nonlinearities, attention, buffers, dropout and full graph trajectory.
parameters_per_layer: 2*M*d+M+R+d; q/u shared, c/a/b member-specific; R canonical non-self relations.
training_objective: Ordinary uniform mean own-member TRAIN CE with exact native masking/normalization and optimizer/state conventions.
served_pool: Fixed mean raw logits followed by softmax.

initialization.q_rule: Balanced ±1 across canonical relations with at least two distinct values, shuffled once by prebound generic seed.
initialization.u_rule: ±1 across output channels from same prebound generic seed convention.

nulls: c0 with identical routes/q,u nonzero gives identical c gradients and zero q/u gradients.
c=q=u=0 kills all product gradients under zero moments and no external perturbation.
q0 with antithetic c/sumc0 and identical routes cancels symmetric pooled q gradient; other gradients0.
Nonzero product can still have zero loss-gradient contractions.
Zero base map entries/features, constant q on relevant relations, irrelevant/canceling relation responses or saturated downstream paths can make local map distinction unobservable.
Nonlinear HGT attention already induces other interactions; local coefficient rank is not complete function-class superiority.
Pure linear common-response pooling can cancel antithetic interaction mean and initial q/u pooled gradients.

representative_test.wider_control_rule: Before outcomes choose smallest source-admissible width preserving8heads and at least CP total trainable parameters.72 is provisional next width; bind actual count and report gap. No post-outcome width choice or exact parameter-equality claim.
representative_test.primary_utility: Heldout predictive NLL with prebound common validation-only scalar-temperature calibration; raw NLL also report.
representative_test.strong_prior_comparison: REEF/HG-Adapter/CHoE/DRSA complete recipes compared at method level; no published scores or stripped methods treated as executed native baselines. Foundation/adaptation claim needs qualified complete native pretraining/graph/objective recipes and all acquisition costs.
representative_test.matched_arms: Same HGT sites/base factor initialization/backbone features/depth/head/state/optimizer/validation budget for global,CP and unrestricted factor arms; wider capacity gap and native author preprocessing differences disclosed.
representative_test.diagnostics: Retain all paired runs; map interaction residuals, relation contributions, member logits/calibration, gradients, storage/peak memory and complete preparation/train/inference cost. No measured diagnostic currently.
representative_test.unrestricted_factor_initialization: Materialize b_mr from CP-generated initial values so its initial function matches CP with identical base maps/input factors/stochastic streams; disclose different free-table versus CP optimization/regularization coordinates.
